narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -8.69 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.1722-0.1770 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 0.1796; the first objective pays 1.09R at 0.1698.

plan.triggerRule: footprint abs fired sell in short direction at the zone
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.1796 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 A/A+ demoted: no positive-delta absorption or CVD divergence at the pullback zone

athena_oracle.verdict: Strong bearish confluence 24/100 — trend broken, flow fading, liq magnets below
